kind.description: What the area does to whoever it covers. Damage falls on the caster's opponents alone; restore mends whoever is standing in it.

damageType.description: Physical damage is reduced by defense, magical by resistance. Ignored when kind is restore.

areaShape.description: Tiles affected around the targeted position.

radius.description: Used only by the diamond shape.

accuracy.description: How often this cast lands, as a whole percentage. Omitted means 100: it always lands and rolls nothing. A damaging area rolls once per opposing unit it covers, and not at all for the caster's own side, which it cannot harm; a restoring ability never rolls.
